chapters.title: A short outing starts with your limits—not a route invented by a model.
“Only blues, no drag lifts, 45 minutes.” This replays one real Qwen3-8B response.
The mistake is visible: “no drag lifts” became a preference, not a hard exclusion.
Correct the hard exclusions locally. The model is not called again.
T-bar, platter and rope-tow are now prohibited. Confirm before planning.
The planner finds a 20-minute simulated outing. Approved constraints stay beside it.
Inspect each leg on the same map. Times include assumed queues—not live conditions.
Save the itinerary locally. Its restrictions and simulation warning travel with it.
Inspect the AI. Correct the constraints. Take away a plan you can examine.

playback_scope: Local Chromium playback and seeks; representative frames visually inspected. Quality counters cover sampled playback, not every viewer/device.
